content:
[Intro]
[C5]

[Verse]
[C5]Every second breaths
life into
a reason for dying.
Our
own ignorance will
only stunt our
final will to live.
Bound and Gagged.
I feel forced
back in a losing race.
I've been
stepped on and
passed by but I
have enough hope to keep
fighting.

[Chorus]
[C5]All of my
life. All of my
pain.
Driven by suffering
All of my
life. All of my
pain.
Driven by suffering
Every single
choice I must
make.
Driven by suffering
Every single
choice I must
make.
Driven by suffering

[Outro]
[C5]
title: Driven by suffering
tuning: C G C F A D
